title: She's All That
tagline: A new comedy that proves there's more to attraction than meets the eye.
about: A dumped high school king bets he can turn the school's quiet art student into prom queen in six weeks.
cue: Serve the fish tacos when Laney goes to the beach with Zack.
faces: "Sometimes when you open up to people, you let the bad in with the good."

    Before the DanceLaney's falafel shift wrapsLaney works her shift in the falafel hat. Crisp falafel with tahini in warm pita.How to make it2 x 400g tins of chickpeas, drained and patted dry1 small brown onion, chopped2 garlic cloves1 cup flat-leaf parsley2 tsp ground cumin3 tbsp plain flour500ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp tahini1 lemon4 pita breads2 tomatoes, dicedPulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and salt to a coarse paste and roll into 16 balls.Fry in hot oil in batches until deep brown and crisp.Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, salt and water until pourable.Warm the pita, fill with falafel and tomato and drizzle with tahini.Simon's breakfast muffinsLaney has his breakfast ready. Get up, Simon.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Taylor's vapor-and-spam musubiTaylor calls Laney vapor and spam. Seared Spam on seasoned rice wrapped in nori.How to make it340g tin SPAM luncheon meat, cut in 8 slices300g sushi rice3 tbsp rice vinegar1 tbsp caster sugar3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp brown sugar4 nori sheets, halved1 tsp sesame seedsCook the rice and season with the vinegar, caster sugar and a pinch of salt.Sear the Spam slices until crisp, then glaze with the soy and brown sugar.Press rice into blocks the size of the Spam and lay a slice on each.Wrap each with a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame.The Main EventHacky sack meatball subsZack's hacky sack routine at the art show. Beef meatballs in red sauce with melted provolone.How to make it600g beef mince60g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg40g parmesan, finely grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700g jar tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long crusty rolls8 slices of provolone1/2 cup basil leavesMix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 20 balls.Brown the meatballs in a hot pan.Add the passata, oregano and the rest of the garlic and simmer until thick.Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with provolone and grill until melted.Tuck in the basil and serve.Beach day fish tacosLaney finally says yes to the beach. Grilled fish tacos with lime slaw and chipotle.How to make it600g firm white fish fillets1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil8 small corn tortillas1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded3 limes125g sour cream1 tbsp chipotle in adobo, chopped1/2 cup coriander leavesRub the fish with the spices, oil and salt.Toss the cabbage with the juice of 2 limes and salt, and stir the chipotle into the sour cream.Grill the fish until just flaking, then break into chunks.Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle cream, coriander and lime.Last Dance SweetsMack's makeover strawberry shortcakeMack gives Laney her makeover. Strawberries and cream on buttermilk shortcake.How to make it250g self-raising flour60g caster sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the berries80g cold butter, cubed180ml buttermilk500g strawberries, sliced300ml thickened cream1 tsp vanilla extractToss the strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar and leave to go juicy.Rub the butter into the flour and 60g sugar, stir in the buttermilk and pat out 3cm thick.Cut 4 rounds and bake at 210°C until golden.Whip the cream with the vanilla, split the shortcakes and fill with berries and cream.The Punch BowlLaney's foghorn prom punchLaney sees off Dean with a foghorn. Pineapple and cranberry punch with lemonade.How to make it500ml pineapple juice500ml cranberry juice750ml lemonade2 limes, sliced1 cup frozen raspberries2 cups ice cubesStir the pineapple and cranberry juices together in a punch bowl.Add the lime slices, frozen raspberries and ice.Top with lemonade just before serving.Sparkling water by the poolNot the last dance. The first.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
